```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
```

```{r load-data}
df <- read_excel("mid-score.xlsx")
df$Note[is.na(df$Note)] <- ""
scores <- df$Score
notes  <- df$Note
```

## Descriptive Statistics

```{r desc-stats}
desc <- data.frame(
  Statistic = c("Minimum", "Q1", "Median", "Q3", "Maximum", "Mean"),
  Value     = c(
    min(scores),
    quantile(scores, 0.25),
    median(scores),
    quantile(scores, 0.75),
    max(scores),
    round(mean(scores), 2)
  )
)
knitr::kable(desc, align = c("l", "r"), caption = "Total Score Distribution Summary")
```

## Score Distribution

```{r boxplot, fig.width=5, fig.height=4, fig.align='center'}
ggplot(df, aes(x = "", y = Score)) +
  geom_boxplot(fill = "#4472C4", colour = "#2F5496",
               outlier.colour = "#C00000", outlier.size = 2) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.15, alpha = 0.5, colour = "#2F5496") +
  labs(title = "Midterm Score Distribution",
       x = NULL, y = "Score (0–100)") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"))
```

## Per-Question Average Score

```{r per-question, fig.width=5, fig.height=4, fig.align='center'}
qcols <- grep("^Q\\d+$", names(df), value = TRUE)
qavg <- data.frame(
  Question = factor(qcols, levels = qcols),
  Average  = sapply(qcols, function(q) round(mean(df[[q]]), 2))
)
ggplot(qavg, aes(x = Question, y = Average)) +
  geom_col(fill = "#4472C4", colour = "#2F5496", width = 0.5) +
  geom_text(aes(label = Average), vjust = -0.4, size = 4) +
  labs(title = "Average Score per Question",
       x = NULL, y = sprintf("Average (0–%g)", 100 / length(qcols))) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"))
```

## Submissions Summary

```{r summary-table}
total   <- nrow(df)
missing <- sum(notes == "Missing")
inv_ip  <- sum(grepl("^Invalid IP", notes))
dup_dev <- sum(grepl("^Duplicate device", notes))
submitted <- total - missing

smry <- data.frame(
  Category = c("Total Students (Roster)",
               "Submitted",
               "Missing",
               "Invalid IP (off-campus)",
               "Duplicate Device"),
  Count = c(total, submitted, missing, inv_ip, dup_dev)
)
knitr::kable(smry, align = c("l", "r"), caption = "Submission Status Summary")
```
